text:
Becca (CSM): CedarPoint asked for a rapid pre-QBR spend check — they saw intermittent embed bursts tied to event-driven reindexes. Need a 90-day forecast (conservative/likely/high), a short ops checklist they can apply immediately, and a sample automated guardrail for their ops team. Renewal ~40 days. cc @Jordan @Marta
Jordan (FinOps): I'll prepare billed-token scenarios using unit $0.00047/token and include $/day and $/month. Should I include a reserved vs on-demand note? Might be useful if they want predictable cost.
Marta (Analytics): Running per-route extraction. SQL I'm using: ```SELECT day, route, SUM(tokens) tokens FROM requests WHERE account='cedarpoint' GROUP BY day, route ORDER BY day DESC LIMIT 120;``` will compute route p95 and mark reindex spikes.
Owen (AE): FYI they use embeddings for product discovery + an event-driven full-sync when content changes. Onboarding ~66%. They called out "surprise spikes due to rapid re-publishes".
Priya (Enablement): I can put together a 15-min "burst mitigation" lab: debounce heuristics for publish events, per-route quotas, prefix caching, and SDK batching. Proposed Thu 9:30am PT.
monitor-bot: [automated] Spike alert: account=cedarpoint 24h avg tokens increased 3.1x (detected 2026-09-12). Baseline threshold = route-level median*2.
Becca (CSM): Jordan, please include three labeled rows (conservative = quick fix stables, likely = current cadence, high = adoption + more events) and add a sensitivity column (+10/30/60%). Also include an example alert rule we can hand them.
Jordan (FinOps): Will do. Draft guard rule for playbook: ```if route('embed-search').avg24h > baseline*2.5 then post('#cs-cost') and POST /webhooks/ops {"acct":"cedarpoint","event":"token_spike"}; optional: set_rate_limit(route='embed-search', pct=50)``` I'll add numbers and rationale in the CSV.
Marta (Analytics): Uploaded CSV -> https://files.redwood/cedarpoint-90d-forecast.csv. Notes: median overall=19k/day; event-driven reindexes produced 3 days >160k; route p95 for embed-search=58k/day. Added 90-day rolling median + p95 chart.
Owen (AE): I'll ask them to flag which publish events are non-critical so we can recommend throttling. Also recommend a short freeze on non-essential re-publishes before renewal.
Priya (Enablement): For the playbook I'll add a copy/paste Webhook + PagerDuty snippet and a runnable SDK example to enable prefix cache TTL and batching: ```client.enable_cache(route='embed-search', ttl=3600)```
Becca (CSM): Good. Also capture feedback: they want per-route invoice mapping and a short checklist for their infra team to prevent accidental blasts.
Jordan (FinOps): For the CSV I'll use $0.00047/token: conservative = 18k tokens/day ($8.46/day, $259/month), likely = 36k tokens/day ($16.92/day, $507/month), high = 95k tokens/day ($44.65/day, $1,339/month) — plus sensitivity ranges.
Marta (Analytics): Added a column showing % of tokens from scheduled jobs vs user-triggered routes. That helps identify what to target first.
Owen (AE): I'll coordinate a short ops runbook with the customer to stagger event triggers and add exponential backoff for retries.
Priya (Enablement): I'll schedule the lab and draft a 1-pager with: 1) quick cache + batching changes, 2) per-route quota example, 3) alert rule + webhook, 4) infra checklist.
monitor-bot: [system] Next summary will post at 14:00 PT with updated route metrics.
Becca (CSM): Can we sync 2pm PT today to finalize the one-pager and the ask? I want the one-pager + CSV + alert snippet ready to share with CedarPoint before the renewal call.
Jordan (FinOps): 14:00 PT works. I'll upload the final three-row forecast table with sensitivity values and a short note on reserved throughput if they want steady-state cost predictability.
Marta (Analytics): I'll join with updated charts and a small screenshot of the per-route breakdown: https://files.redwood/cedarpoint-route-screenshot.png
Priya (Enablement): I'll bring the lab agenda and copy-paste config snippets.
Owen (AE): I'll confirm the customer infra contact and request logs showing when re-publishes were triggered.
Becca (CSM): Thanks team 8640; goal is to give CedarPoint a reproducible path to predictable spend and a short checklist they can run immediately to avoid any surprise invoice items at renewal.
